description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing channel bookmarks in Mattermost, including create, delete, edit, reorder, and fetch operations.

methods.name: deleteBookmark
methods.description: Deletes a channel bookmark by calling the API and dispatching a delete action.

methods.name: createBookmark
methods.description: Creates a new channel bookmark via API and dispatches a received action.

methods.name: editBookmark
methods.description: Edits an existing channel bookmark, updating or deleting it based on API response.

methods.name: reorderBookmark
methods.description: Reorders channel bookmarks by updating their sort order via API and dispatching an update.

methods.name: fetchChannelBookmarks
methods.description: Fetches all bookmarks for a channel, handling errors and dispatching the data.
